question: Can the received D1-D2 axis be mounted to the fixed lower frame with finite-thickness panels and move continuously from -34 to +34 degrees while the crown and lid remain fixed?
intendedContacts: shaft to moving sleeve pivot interface
shaft within D1/D2 bores with declared radial clearance
D1/D2 pedestals and rail bonded to fixed lower frame
moving and fixed panels inside the declared 0.02 u hinge exclusion strip
unwantedCollisionTargets: fixed lower panel outside hinge strip

method.distanceModel: segment-triangle, triangle-triangle and capsule envelopes; finite panel thickness subtracted from mid-surface distances; housing opening also certified analytically by angular envelope

negativeBaseline.reason: A closed 360-degree housing occupies the annulus crossed by the unnotched finite-thickness moving leaf at both D1 and D2.
negativeBaseline.smallestChange: Open the existing housing toward +y; retain axis, bearings, shaft, panel thickness and all other dimensions.

forceBoundary.interpretation: Zero resultant force does not imply zero hinge moment after folding.

conclusion: The D1-D2 axis is geometrically mounted to a fixed lower rail by two C-open bearing candidates and remains collision-free in the declared -34 to +34 degree model under the chosen dimensions. Physical retention strength, tolerances, fasteners, friction, actuator loads, material deformation and prototype verification remain open.
